description.zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID 所在的 Cell
description.en: The cell where the consumer group ID to query resides.

description.zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID
description.en: The consumer group ID to query.

description.zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID 所对应的实例 ID。针对有独立命名空间的实例，该参数为必填。
description.en: The instance ID that corresponds to the consumer group ID to query. This parameter is required for instances that have independent namespaces.

description.zh: 需查询的消费端 Group ID 订阅的 Topic
description.en: The topic subscribed to by the consumer group ID to query.
